scope: Existing 1024 documents, layer31, same aligned4096-channel paired residual/MLP/sum stages; no intervention/GPU

definitions.Ea: sum||current second-residual base - reference second-residual base||²
definitions.Em: sum||current MLP branch - reference MLP branch||²
definitions.Ef: sum||actual current FP32 residual sum - actual reference FP32 residual sum||²
definitions.signal: reference path vectors at corresponding stages
definitions.cosine: uncentered cross/sqrt(component energies), not a Pearson coefficient
definitions.signal_Pearson: Unavailable: component reference signed sums were not saved. Error centered Pearson is available from signed_error_sum.

limitations: Algebraic energy terms are signed descriptive terms, not causal percentages of rounding sources.
Different stage dimensions must not be ranked by total energy; these three stages share coordinates and units.
Signal recovered cross includes reference FP32-add rounding. Its magnitude is bounded using u=2^-24 plus subnormal absolute term.
Error saved direct cross permits a measured scalar energy-identity remainder. That remainder equals2<ea+em,delta_add>+||delta_add||² and is not the add-round error energy alone.
No full1024 residual/branch raw vectors exist to measure add-round vector norm exactly; conservative bounds are supplied.
ratio_formula: sqrt((Ef/Sf)/(Ea/Sa)); same-coordinate pooled energies, not a difference of relative percentages
